about.heading: Telling stories that matter
paragraphs: I started at a digital marketing agency, launching campaigns for Philips and fast-growing consumer brands. It taught me what makes people click, watch and share.

A master’s in New Media Storytelling at USC Annenberg took me to Los Angeles, where I produced immersive journalism for NPR, Al Jazeera, KCRW and Google, worked on advocacy campaigns at 72andSunny, and made a VR documentary that won a Webby Award.

Since 2019 I’ve been with the United Nations Development Programme (UNDP), starting in New Delhi and now in New York. I plan, write, shoot and edit campaigns on climate change, gender equality, poverty, crisis and digital transformation for audiences worldwide.
I work where strategy meets creativity. I write the brief, shape the idea, plan the distribution, make the film, and read the data that shows what worked.
